decision: Exclude the unreferenced high-level-language interface macro library from the selected three-component build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
No include of cmacros.inc appears in the retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include trees or frozen dependency inventory; version.inc mentions it only in a comment.
Searches for representative C-interface macro invocations found no uses outside cmacros.inc in the selected source trees.
The three selected reference build reports have no cmacros input.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected three-component build; it does not establish that this library was absent from other DOS products or build configurations.
